description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the SortOption interface, managing a list of sort entries, providing methods for creation, manipulation, and representation of sorting options in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableSortOption
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the SortOption interface, representing a sorted collection of SortOptionEntry objects with utility methods for modification and inspection.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableSortOption instance with the specified list of entries.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing OptionVisitor to perform operations on this SortOption.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of the contained SortOptionEntry objects.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new ImmutableSortOption with the specified entry added.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new SortOptionEntry based on property path and order, returning a new ImmutableSortOption.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in this sort option.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if this sort option has no entries.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a Stream over the entries.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the entries.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object based on entries list.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on entries.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation, formatted as 'sort(entry1,entry2,...)' or empty if no entries.
